（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL · JUNCTA JUVANT · POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commonor 5 V.C.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 196
Date. 1/3
February 25th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has received a code telegram from Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang 馮國璋 of Nanking instructing him to be ready to dispatch nine hundred more troops to Nanking when called upon.
With reference to the report of yesterday's date regarding the departure of nine hundred soldiers for Nanking, it is now said that when the troops got the order to leave they grumbled a good deal because they thought they were being sent to Yunnan, and it was only after their officers had assured them that this was not the case and that they were really being sent to Nanking that they quietened down.
A high military officer named Woo Tsung Wo 何振華 arrived at the Arsenal on 23rd instant from Peking. He brought dispatches from the Central Government instructing General Yang to take special precautions against rebels who should be severely dealt with when caught. Woo, General Yang, Yang Tcheng, Commissioner for Foreign Affairs, and Li Tsung Nyoh 李宗 Director of the Arsenal Works had tiffin together at the Arsenal yesterday when they discussed measures for preserving the loyalty of the troops in Shanghai. The officer from the capital suggested that the troops be formed up, and the justice of Yuan's cause explained to them. He also thought it would be advisable to inform them of the real situation in Yunnan, as rebel agents would be likely to spread false rumours among them regarding rebel victories etc. After tiffin the officials went by launch to Woosung where they conferred with General Lu.
It is reported that General Aoki will leave for Peking on 27th instant.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Feb. 25.
Seen by CIP

警务处，
（侦探部）

Commonor 5 V.C.

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
编号 196
日期. 1/3
1916年2月25日。

先生：
据报，杨将军收到来自南京冯国璋（馮國璋）的一封密码电报，指示他做好准备，一旦受召即向南京增派九百名士兵。
关于昨日报告中提及的九百名士兵开赴南京一事，现称士兵们在接到出发命令时曾大肆抱怨，因为他们以为是被派往云南；直到军官们向他们保证并非如此，并确证他们确实是前往南京后，他们才平静下来。
一位名为何振華（Woo Tsung Wo）的高级军官于本月23日从北京抵达兵工厂。他带来了中央政府的公文，指示杨将军对叛乱分子采取特别防范措施，并在抓获后予以严惩。昨日，吴氏、杨将军、外交专员杨晟（Yang Tcheng）以及兵工厂总监李宗岳（Li Tsung Nyoh，音译）在兵工厂共进午餐，期间讨论了维持上海驻军忠诚度的措施。这位来自京城的军官建议召集部队，并向他们阐明袁世凯事业的正义性。他还认为，宜将云南的真实局势告知士兵，因为叛乱分子的代理人很可能在军中散布关于叛军获胜等虚假谣言。午餐后，官员们乘汽艇前往吴淞，与卢将军会商。
据报，青木将军将于本月27日启程前往北京。

您顺从的仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警察总巡官。

2月25日。
首席侦探督察阅
